sets.name: BloodSplat
sets.atlas: 2 x 2 variants, 512 px cells; pick one cell per placement, random yaw
sets.size_m: one cell covers about 0.9 x 0.9 m (the pool is 0.3-0.4 m across)
sets.material: deferred decal, translucent blend: base colour = BC.rgb, opacity = BC.a, normal = N (OpenGL: flip green), roughness = ORM.G (0.07 wet centre to 0.6 dried rim), metallic 0, specular 0.5; no emissive
sets.known_weaknesses: procedural: streaks are straight tapered lines, droplets are ellipses, there is no soak-in tint on porous ground and no directional cast-off pattern; four variants only

sets.name: BurnHole
sets.size_m: one cell covers about 1.2 x 1.2 m (the charred pit is 0.5-0.6 m across)
sets.material: deferred decal, translucent blend: base colour = BC.rgb, opacity = BC.a (scorch halo fades out), normal = N (sunk pit with a raised lip and crazed char), roughness = ORM.G, AO = ORM.R, metallic 0; optional faint ember emissive is not authored
sets.known_weaknesses: procedural: the crazing is an even cell pattern, ash is flecks of flat grey, no burnt debris or soot streak downwind; a decal cannot really sink the ground (normal only)
